sample_unit: paired expert comparisons (10 questions x 9 raters)
models_evaluated: LightRAG with gpt-oss-20b and Qwen3 embeddings

links.outcome: Blinded expert preference and completeness for grounded RAG answers versus ungrounded GPT-4.5 answers
links.effect: RAG preferred in 47.8% of 90 paired comparisons vs 35.6% for GPT-4.5; completeness 3.84 vs 3.51 (p = 0.016); significant advantage on ETP-ALL immunophenotype definition (p = 0.016).
links.quote: In expert evaluation, RAG was preferred in 47.8% of 90 paired comparisons versus 35.6% for GPT-4.5, with higher completeness scores (3.84 vs 3.51, p = 0.016).

unlisted_practices: Converting textbook figures and tables into structured text with a multimodal LLM for knowledge graph construction
Knowledge graph-guided retrieval (LightRAG) for clinical question answering
LLM-as-judge evaluation alongside blinded human expert evaluation

screen.reason: The study evaluates a multimodal knowledge-graph RAG framework against a baseline foundation LLM (GPT-4.5) to assess whether retrieval grounding improves completeness and accuracy of clinical decision support responses, evaluated by expert clinicians and LLM evaluators.
